name: dn-leaf-shorter-than-constraint-invalid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName is C=US,O=Example,OU=Engineering (three RDNs). The leaf subject is C=US,O=Example (two RDNs). The constraint can only match a name that starts with the constraint as its prefix; a shorter name cannot contain that prefix and the leaf must be rejected.
notes: Implementations that test the constraint as a substring (or that compare DNs by ignoring trailing RDNs of either side) may wrongly accept this.
